name: kettlebell standing slingshots (advanced)
description: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.
